source: Author requested eight more Manufactured stock items, October 15, 2026. Specific materials, processing stages and uses remain design proposals.

defaults.Acquisition: Proposed workshop manufacture or trade in prepared stock; regional access and availability remain undefined.
defaults.Crafting / processing: Candidate intermediate stock for later fitted fabrication. Processing inputs and planning stage are proposed; no executable recipe, material quantity, yield or manufacturing time is authored.
defaults.Limitations: Dimensions, material grade, tolerances, service conditions and compatibility remain open. A shaped blank does not grant a fitted component, certified protection or an operating machine.
defaults.Classification basis: Author-requested expansion of manufactured stock: worked materials awaiting fitted fabrication, separate from finished equipment and as-found salvage.
defaults.Tier basis: Proposed T2 stock using qualified T1 metal or ceramic feed. The planning stage does not establish a recipe, production access or material performance.

items.name: Perforated iron sheet stock
items.purpose: Worked iron sheet with a repeating pattern of punched openings, intended for ventilation faces, sorting screens or protective equipment covers. Hole pattern and useful clearances await design; this is stock rather than a finished filter.
items.icon: A slightly curved iron sheet with rows of punched holes and an unfinished edge.

items.name: Flanged iron channel stock
items.purpose: Lengths of worked iron folded into a shallow channel with outward mounting lips. Candidate stock for lightweight frames, camp fittings and casing supports; it needs cutting and fitting before assembly.
items.icon: Three staggered lengths of shallow U-shaped iron channel with flat outward lips.

items.name: Corrugated steel sheet stock
items.purpose: Prepared steel sheet formed into parallel ridges for proposed housings, stiffened covers or wind-facing panels. It remains an unfitted sheet; strength, weight and acceptable forming methods are undecided.
items.icon: A short steel sheet with five broad corrugations and uneven cut ends.

fields.Tier basis: Proposed T3 forming stock using T2 steel stock. Forming sequence, tooling and resulting properties remain proposals.

items.name: Hollow ceramic tube blanks
items.purpose: Unfitted fired ceramic tube lengths for selected spacers, protected guides or candidate nonconductive passages. Cutting, bore finish and service qualification remain necessary; no voltage, heat or chemical rating is assigned.
items.icon: Three thick-walled ceramic tubes of different lengths, their rough open bores visible.

items.name: Fired ceramic ring blanks
items.purpose: Rough fired ceramic rings awaiting grinding and matching to a particular assembly. They supply stock for potential collars or spacers, distinct from the catalog's fitted insulating spacer and matched spacer sets.
items.icon: A small stack of thick ceramic rings with rough rims and mismatched inner openings.

items.name: Laminated mica shim stock
items.purpose: Thin layered mica strips proposed for fitted gap adjustment and separation between compatible surfaces. Thickness, binder choice and useful insulating behavior require qualification; this is not a guaranteed electrical barrier.
items.icon: A fan of thin amber-grey mineral strips showing layered edges and staggered lengths.

fields.Tier basis: Proposed T3 finishing and thickness-selection stage using T2 mica composite sheet. Composition, separation method and tolerances remain unresolved.

items.name: Copper capillary tube stock
items.purpose: Fine-bore copper tubing proposed for fitted instrument passages or the controlled transfer of compatible contained substances. It does not imply a water system, safe biological contact or a particular flow rate; bore consistency and cleaning remain open.
items.icon: A loose coil of narrow copper tube with two short straight offcuts showing tiny open bores.

fields.Tier basis: Proposed T3 fine forming from T2 drawn copper stock. Tooling, bore control and process qualification are not established.

items.name: Hammered bronze foil stock
items.purpose: Very thin worked bronze sheets proposed for decorative cladding, shaped labels or selected fitted metal layers. Thickness, alloy, joining and durability remain undecided; it is distinct from thicker drawn bronze strip stock.
items.icon: Several thin warm-brown metal leaves with curled corners and small hammer facets.

fields.Tier basis: Proposed T3 thinning and finishing using T2 bronze stock. Annealing, hammering sequence, usable thickness and yield remain design work.
